elements.text:
On Instagram, you see that it's the birthday of someone you are acquainted with. You comment on their post congratulating them. Later on, you see that this person has liked a lot of the congratulatory messages but not yours. Why is this? 

This person has received so many congratulatory messages and has just missed mine. 

On a scale of 1-5, how likely is this thought to pop into your mind?

buttons: 1::1: Doesn't pop up in my mind;2::2;3::3: Might pop up in my mind;4::4;5::5: Definitely pops up in my mind;
